title: Rosewater Lane Rising Anew
author: Astrid Hartwell
blurb: Theo Ravensworth, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
